user_saw: With a microphone that sent digital silence between utterances, Gemini 3.8 Live gave no reply and could merge the stalled utterance into the next user transcript.
summary: The Google realtime voice bridge now keeps forwarding client-supplied silent audio to both Gemini 3.8 Live variants so server-side voice activity detection can complete the turn.
reasoning: The live API probes show that the existing silence cutoff completed turns on Gemini 3.1 but stalled both Gemini 3.8 Live variants, which need trailing audio for voice activity detection. I checked that the bridge already accepted configurable model IDs and dropped silent frames after sending audioStreamEnd before #152413, which added model-specific compatibility without changing that cutoff. The cutoff predates the shallow history boundary, and I found no in-repo change that first exposed the provider incompatibility.
